text: {"lessons":["My account has moved up and down even when I made no trades, so I should expect fluctuations and avoid reacting impulsively to one month’s result.","Selling 20 shares of Stock A at a gain realized a profit, but one sale does not show whether the timing was right; I should make trades for a clear portfolio reason, not just because a stock has risen.","Because these savings help fund retirement, I should prioritize manageable risk and keep enough cash for living needs rather than chase short-term gains or trade frequently."]}
